System / one outcome

Accountability
without ceremony.

A sparse organisation gives each outcome one owner, gives production a real worker, and keeps the Exec free for what comes next.

01

Exec

Owns the portfolio. Delegates every executable request to exactly one lead, then returns to availability.

02

Accountable lead

Owns one coherent outcome. Supervises rather than produces. Frames, observes, redirects, repairs and judges.

03

Staff

Produces the actual work. One strong end-to-end worker is the default until another stable seam earns its coordination cost.

04

Owner

Receives the live outcome and the prepared judgement call, not the organisation’s internal traffic.

Three logical layers

Judgement above.
Rules at the boundary.
Work in the world.

  1. Constitutional Kernel

    Deterministic authority, identity, secrets, budgets, consequential effects and recovery.

  2. Organisational Intelligence

    Goals, actors, sparse Work, Attempts, messages and repair. Recoverable and overridable.

  3. Company Linux Runtime

    Persistent files, Git, browsers and ordinary tools where outcomes are made.

Outcome-native review

Review the thing itself.

A live site, playable build, rendered document, image or executable scenario comes first. Commits, tests and receipts support the judgement. They do not replace it.
